direction: Explore diverse priority mechanisms while preserving the frozen online bin-packing interface
hypothesis: The first round measures validity and distinguishable training behavior; no improvement on the saturated mini baseline is assumed.

operations.mechanism: Explore residual-capacity, item-size and nonlinear priority combinations without changing the interface

preserve: Frozen online-bin-packing interface, immutable inputs, capability contract and benchmark metric
reasoning_summary: Use the historical neutral initial mechanism, then inspect trusted per-candidate and per-instance facts before choosing the next mechanism.
